component.name: LLM Hub
component.summary: Run AI models on this computer

description.p: LLM Hub runs language models on your own computer with llama.cpp and LiteRT-LM. Chat with Gemma and other open models, let an agent work in a folder, design pages and slides, and make images, video and music in the studio.
A local API serves the installed models to other apps in OpenAI and Anthropic format. Engines and models are downloaded on first use, and chats stay on this computer.
